sources.title: OpenStreetMap
sources.allowed_use: Geographic database input with attribution and ODbL compliance for publicly used derived databases.
sources.metadata_quality: Element IDs, tags, version timestamps in API output; field completeness varies by mapper and place.

sources.title: BCDA 2014 Annual Report
sources.license: No open reuse license identified; research/reference only
sources.allowed_use: Scope and planning evidence; do not redistribute embedded media without permission.
sources.metadata_quality: Authoritative agency publication; states 240-hectare first-phase development.

sources.title: Administrative Order No. 269, s. 1996
sources.license: Official government issuance; verify reuse status for attached plans
sources.allowed_use: Evidence that an official Fort Bonifacio Master Development Plan exists; not a machine-readable boundary.

sources.title: ULI Case Study: Bonifacio Global City
sources.license: No open reuse license identified; research/reference only
sources.allowed_use: Planning/reference evidence only; do not redistribute imagery.
sources.metadata_quality: Documents the 3×3 city-center grid, east-west High Street pedestrian axis, and open-space strategy.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons
sources.license: Per-file open license or public-domain status
sources.attribution: Per-file author, title, source, license, and change indication
sources.allowed_use: Use only after storing and checking each file's extmetadata and license requirements.
sources.metadata_quality: Strong page/author/license metadata; geolocation and capture date are optional.

sources.title: Mapillary
sources.license: CC BY-SA for contributed imagery; API/terms also apply
sources.attribution: Image title/link, contributor/profile link, and CC BY-SA notice
sources.allowed_use: Reference imagery with per-image provenance and share-alike review; API access requires a token.
sources.metadata_quality: Geolocation, capture time, compass angle, sequence and panorama metadata may be available.

sources.title: Official building, developer, and BGC websites
sources.license: Generally copyrighted unless a page states otherwise
sources.allowed_use: Research and factual observation; no bulk download or redistribution without permission.
sources.metadata_quality: Good identity and current marketing views; geolocation, camera pose, and dates are often absent.

sources.title: Future user-supplied photography
sources.allowed_use: Only according to captured consent, license, and privacy restrictions.
sources.metadata_quality: Potentially excellent when capture position, direction, date, and target building are required fields.
